evidence.decision: Chooses card, caption, monogram or poster and treats header/content/footer as one focusable unit with matching tilt and expansion space.
evidence.artifact: Requires focused/unfocused layouts, chosen form, focus bounds, hierarchy and activation outcome.
evidence.transformation: TV cast grid replaces independent portrait scaling with whole monograms, consistent sizing, expansion clearance and initials fallback.
evidence.verification: Traverses edges/corners and verifies neighbors, labels and fallback identity; fails overlapping or detached focused content.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly tvOS-only; other-platform adaptation retains content relationship through supported components without claiming native lockups.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Designing for tvOS for platform navigation and Collections for surrounding grids.
evidence.distinctiveness: Atomic header/footer focus growth, monogram fallback and navigation-axis tilt are unique lockup decisions.
